required_local_exact_gate.required: Drive actual accepted new selection with old counts0,1,511,512 and retired ID reader; sample after NBA. Assert whole512-bit present=0, npresent=0 and rows_ready=0. Keep original ef812 failure immutable and compare companion on identical input.

On accepted new-selection edge exercise each of five wv sources and simultaneous-source masks. Source order is local f_ov&&ag_tx_ready, three remote ag_rx_valid, new_sel_pulse. Assert all collector write enables blocked, bitmap/count zero, sticky collision fault asserted and no collector buf_row overwrite; old data storage remains unchanged. Count-only reset is insufficient.
Verify old nwr does not restore count, rows-ready timing or local/remote statistics after clear; check fault priority and next-cycle sticky fault. Do not silently accept old row on following edge.

Without new selection preserve exact existing valid unique0..5-source updates, rank/GID/out-of-range/duplicate faults and data bits; define acceptance by source edge, not presented data. Preserve existing no-reset arithmetic including width behavior.

Use !==/=== plus explicit unknown detection for selection acceptance, rd_act, wv, write enables, bitmap/count/fault. A valid comparator must fail X rather than let if(expr!=expected) evaluate unknown and escape.

Gate same-edge and delayed arrivals separately. Clear is an accepted-selection transition, not merely sel_v high while rd_act is active. Require no old ownership/pending-response state at allowed epoch hop, and no early owner credit release. No generation-clearing proof from reset bitmap alone.

delayed_old_response_requirements.reason: Three peer RX lanes carry valid/rank/gid/row but no ready or epoch; collector accepts each wv. Rank/GID can be valid in both epochs. A counter mux and same-edge guard cannot identify a delayed old row after clear.
required_inputs: Old local fetch outstanding requests/returns/output held rows, encoder/new_sel_pulse and collector write pipelines must be empty before selection is accepted.
Each old peer source and every finite hop must expose accepted-edge ownership and drain completion, including queued, held and delayed RX rows; retain credits through collector write capture.
Explicit source/destination/epoch mapping and wrap/reuse drain; no host-injected epoch field counted as real wire identity.

If using no new epoch port/state, enforce zero old in-flight returns at the actual selection boundary with a source-selected finite provider; test delayed old response causes selection refusal until captured/drained.
If delayed arrivals are allowed past the boundary, price actual identity/check/state/port/CDC changes before RTL; current zero-state cost does not cover them.
Current consumer/backend completion must release old ownership only after actual visibility and accepted completion, not column issue or ready acceptance.
delayed_old_response_requirements.positive_boundary_gate: Delay an old valid response until after proposed selection; show actual guard refuses hop while outstanding, retires old row, then allows clear. With current endpoint no such provider binding has been demonstrated.
delayed_old_response_requirements.negative_boundary_gate: Inject delayed old arrival into an unguarded hop to expose missing assumption; do not classify a host-tagged rejection as hardware epoch enforcement.

readiness_scope: Local counter/same-edge companion exactness can proceed at priced control scope; whole epoch/reselection safety remains pending actual finite provider. Mandatory correctness is independent of full-die power and rate gain, with physical/adoption qualification separate.
